name: Sanna Korhonen
bio:
Sanna's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a family racing legacy, but through a fascination with the precision engineering of aircraft. After completing her degree in Aerospace Engineering, she specialized in composite materials, drawn to their strength-to-weight ratio and design flexibility. A chance encounter with a Formula Student team sparked her interest in applying her skills to racing, leading her to a position with a smaller GT outfit before joining Iron Dames.

Her approach to composite repair and fabrication is meticulous and detail-oriented, a direct reflection of her perfectionist tendencies. She believes in understanding the 'why' behind every material choice and process, which allows her to not only execute repairs flawlessly but also to suggest innovative improvements. This drive for innovation and her unflinching loyalty to her team make her a valuable asset.

Sanna's background in aerospace provides her with a unique perspective on the stresses and strains experienced by racing components. She is always looking for ways to improve the durability and performance of the car's composite structures, constantly researching new materials and techniques, ensuring that the team is always at the cutting edge.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided and often tucked under a beanie.
physical.description: Sanna is of average height with a lean build, her focused gaze reflecting her meticulous nature.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with material specifications and diagrams.
Insists on using a specific type of carbon fiber cloth for all repairs.
Hums quietly to herself when concentrating on intricate tasks.
